chapters.name: Chapter 1: Voronezh
chapters.intro: Third winter after the Breach. The southern edge of Voronezh: empty panel blocks, frozen garages and the ruins of the nuclear heating plant where it all began. The colony needs fuel, roads and answers.

missions.name: Cold Start
missions.place: Shilovo, the gas station and the garages
missions.debrief: Shilovo is ours: the gas station, the garages and the empty blocks. The HQ stands in the yards - this is where the colony starts again.

missions.name: Holdout
missions.debrief: The base held. The convoy brought fuel, people and a rumour: the gangs' fuel comes from the rail depot east of the city.

missions.name: Rail Depot
missions.place: Sortie: the frozen rail yard east of the city
missions.debrief: The depot burned, and the signal box gave us the Grad papers. The prisoners all say the same thing: they fled from a violet glow in the south.

missions.name: Glow over the Plant
missions.place: From the base to the ruins of the Voronezh nuclear heating plant
missions.debrief: The rift at the plant is closed, but the crystals are still growing in the ruins. Whatever came through the Breach is not done with us.
